propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces wall-clock time due to per-test git init spawning (306ms, 58 spawns per test, 589 tests requesting it).
Build initialized repo once per xdist worker using tmp_path_factory, then copy per test with shutil.copytree to reduce 306ms per test to 22.3ms (13.7x speedup).

Copies require four distinct fix-ups: rewrite absolute worktree pointers (.tickets-tracker/.git and gitdir), set REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR per test, re-randomize .env-id and .signing-key unconditionally, and reset _pending_cache module-global.
Template fixture must build inside isolated MonkeyPatch context setting REBAR_ROOT and clearing tracker-related env vars to prevent autouse environment contamination.
Tier-wide autouse guard must validate all git worktree paths resolve inside REBAR_ROOT using 'git worktree list --porcelain', not the weaker --git-common-dir check.
Sentinel tests must prove half-fixed copies are rejected, bare git worktree repair is rejected, no template path leaks into copies, and per-test env-id/signing-key are distinct.
